tasks.label: flash debug (OpenOCD)
tasks.command: openocd -f interface/stlink.cfg -f target/stm32f1x.cfg -c "program build/debug/bringup_bluepill.elf verify reset exit"

tasks.label: host tests (CRC)
tasks.command: cmake -S tests -B build/tests -G Ninja && cmake --build build/tests && ctest --test-dir build/tests --output-on-failure
